import unittest

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import copy
        from crates import totals
        rows = [{'orchard':'青岭','crates':4}, {'orchard':'河湾','crates':2},
                {'orchard':'青岭','crates':3}, {'orchard':'河湾','crates':-1},
                {'orchard':'南坡','crates':0}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(rows)
        self.assertEqual(totals(rows), {'青岭':7,'河湾':1,'南坡':0})
        self.assertEqual(rows, before)
        self.assertEqual(totals([]), {})
        self.assertEqual(totals([{'orchard':'松园','crates':8}]), {'松园':8})
        self.assertEqual(totals([{'orchard':'青岭','crates':1}]), {'青岭':1})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# orchard-crate-totals

totals(deliveries) 将到货记录列表按 orchard 汇总 crates 整数之和，返回字典。记录不保证按果园分组；同一果园的所有记录都计入，包括 0 和负数调整。空列表返回 {}，不修改输入。

验证：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。保持公开接口和 tests/ 下的断言；仅使用 Python 3.12 标准库。
